resources.string: Add all-apps grid to Home screen
All launchable apps in one scrollable widget. Your launcher may ask once. Separate icons still need individual launcher approval.
Confirm once in your launcher to add the whole grid. If you dismiss it, tap here to try again.
All-apps grid added. Resize it on your Home screen and scroll to see every app.
Your existing all-apps grid has been refreshed.
Open your launcher’s Widgets menu, choose Hail · All apps, and drag the grid to your Home screen. This launcher does not support adding it from Hail.
Your launcher no longer has Hail’s app grid. Tap here to add it again with one confirmation.
No launchable apps in this Android profile. Tap Refresh to check again.
Refresh existing Hail shortcuts and the app grid. If your launcher erased its layout, add the grid again above.
Existing shortcuts and app grids refreshed.
Could not refresh every shortcut. Your existing shortcuts were kept; tap to retry.
